_comment: THE per-site identity file — the only file that changes between loisirs74/73/38/…  Engine scripts read it via scripts/siteconfig.py and must never hardcode these values. department.name_i18n is deliberately ABSENT here: the 73 freezes the French place name in every language per docs/LAUNCH-PLAN.md, so dept_name(lang) falls back to "Savoie" everywhere. The 74 needs it because it renders "Alta Savoia" and "Alta Saboya".
adjacent_scope_note: Adjacent regions (Haute-Savoie 74, Isère 38, Hautes-Alpes 05) not covered.
